title: Sourdough Discard Blueberry Bagels

ingredients: 200g sourdough discard, unfed, at room temperature
1 egg white + 15g water for egg wash
directions: Combine flour, 1 tablespoon granulated sugar, salt, and instant yeast in the bowl of a stand mixer with a dough hook. Stir to combine.
Coarsely crush or purée the blueberries in a food processor until you have about 1 cup (220g) crushed berries.
Add the sourdough discard and crushed blueberries to the dry ingredients. On low speed, slowly pour in warm water. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Turn out onto a work surface and knead for 4–5 minutes until smooth and not sticky. Add more flour or water (1 tablespoon at a time) as needed.
Transfer to a large greased bowl, cover, and let rise for 90 minutes or until doubled.
Divide into 8 equal pieces. Roll each into a smooth ball, press thumb through the center, and stretch to form bagel shape. Cover and rest 20 minutes.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment. Bring 2 quarts water and 2 tablespoons granulated sugar to a boil.
Boil bagels 15–30 seconds per side. Remove with a slotted spoon and transfer to baking sheets.
Brush with egg wash and sprinkle with toppings if desired.
Bake for 18–22 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool fully before slicing.

notes: To use active sourdough starter, omit the yeast and replace discard with active starter (200g). Adjust rise times. If using frozen blueberries, let thaw before crushing — thawing ensures accurate water content.
